structured.rankingRationale: Highest priority goes to One Future, LabFaB and CGNA because they combine verified dates/venues with a credible multi-day delegate or accommodation mechanism. Campus events follow because they can generate delegate/speaker/side-meeting demand but publish no hotel sourcing. Confirmed competing hotels, airport venues and North York arenas are downgraded to monitor/future capture.

notesForDeepResearch: Verify restaurant/lounge and current F&B capability before promising catering.
For campus and competing-hotel events, identify overflow, speaker, exhibitor or future-edition sourcing before outreach.
Confirm room counts and organizer contacts directly; none are inferred.
materialUncertainties: Most candidates do not publish room blocks, peak rooms or hotel sourcing; silence is treated as unconfirmed, not open.
Several events are at confirmed competing hotels or outside the core harbourfront territory and are monitor/future-capture opportunities only.
Attendance is not published for most candidates and is not estimated.
